Impregnated Kunti (Nutan) dumps her lover to marry a rich barrister. But she's unable to abort the illegitimate child, so she gives birth to and abandons the infant, who grows up to become the beautiful Munmun (Rekha). Munmun finds out the truth about her mother after her graduation and sets out to dig the past.

A family of five is separated in an unfortunate incident. The three brothers are raised in different religious households. As fate would have it, the family reunites after several years and avenges those responsible for their separation.

Raju, an heir to millions of riches, is devoted to his manipulative stepmother who ploys to extort his wealth. But when Raju's newly-wed wife sees through her plan, she staunchly opposes her, which sets off a war of wits between the two women.

Madhu and Raja fall in love and decide to get married. However  Madhu's two elder brothers oppose their alliance as Raja does not come from a wealthy family. As the story progresses  the couple discovers that their families share a bitter past.

Subjected to repeated rejection and failure, an aspiring actor takes to drinking and womanising to divert his mind. His life collapses further when he finds out that he has caught STD. Will he find the will to live or simply take an easy way out?
Sapna, a Psychiatrist, falls in love with her patient Karan. When Karan gets normal, he asks Sapna to get married. But she disapproves of this relationship. What could be the reason?

Gopal’s life hits choppy waters when he gets stuck on a yacht for a night upon rescuing an attractive young woman by fighting off some goons. Now, he has his wife suspecting him of having an affair and a police officer on his tail.

Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.
Madhumitha loves Vishu, who happens to have a twin brother. When Vishu's father insists that his sons will only marry twin sisters, Madhumitha pretends to be her own twin.
